user.title: Set up HomeAI
user.description: HomeAI notices what changes in your home, decides what to do, fixes what it can and tells you only when a person is needed. It works without AI; AI tiers can be added later as subentries.

data_description.privacy: Standard sends device, room and people names. Minimal replaces people and rooms with neutral labels. Full also sends calendar event titles.

people.title: People
people.description: Choose each person's role. Administrators approve risky actions and configuration changes; members get notifications; guests and ignored people are not tracked as residents. People: {people}

abort.single_instance_allowed: HomeAI is already set up. Only one instance is allowed.

init.title: HomeAI options
init.description: Choose what to change. Values set here apply to the whole home; under **Settings for a place** a floor, area, device, entity or person can have its own. Rules and AI connections are added on the integration's page.

menu_option_descriptions.general: Language, parts of the day, journal and panel.
menu_option_descriptions.world: Which entities HomeAI watches and the labels it understands.
menu_option_descriptions.presence: Roles, house mode and how HomeAI knows who sleeps.
menu_option_descriptions.privacy: What may be sent to cloud AI.
menu_option_descriptions.detectors: What HomeAI watches and its limits.
menu_option_descriptions.notify: Who hears what, how and when.
menu_option_descriptions.policy: What HomeAI may do on its own, what needs a yes, and what never happens.
menu_option_descriptions.executor: How actions are run, checked and undone.
menu_option_descriptions.repair: How HomeAI fixes things before bothering anyone.
menu_option_descriptions.adapters: Knowledge about hubs, bridges and Zigbee2MQTT.
menu_option_descriptions.schedule: The home's plan and presence exceptions.
menu_option_descriptions.heating: Thermostats that speak HomeAI's schedule contract: overrides HomeAI sets by itself from presence, and weekly schedule changes it proposes.
menu_option_descriptions.prompts: Your own instructions for each AI task. Empty: the built-in prompt (shown in the diagnostics).
menu_option_descriptions.learning: Norms, anomalies, habits and the weekly review.
menu_option_descriptions.place: A floor, area, device, entity or person with values of its own.
menu_option_descriptions.undo: Restore the value from before the most recent change.
menu_option_descriptions.reset: Every value of one section back to its default; values for places stay.

general.title: General
general.description: Language, parts of the day, journal and panel.

data_description.general_language: Language of HomeAI's notifications, journal and AI replies. Auto follows Home Assistant.
data_description.general_assistant_name: How HomeAI calls itself in messages and conversations.
data_description.general_night_start: Start of the night part of the day.
data_description.general_morning_start: Start of the morning part of the day.
data_description.general_day_start: Start of the day part of the day.
data_description.general_evening_start: Start of the evening part of the day.
data_description.general_journal_retention_days: How long entries stay in HomeAI's journal.
data_description.general_panel_sidebar: Show HomeAI's panels in Home Assistant's sidebar.
data_description.general_panels: The panels HomeAI adds to the sidebar. Each person can still hide any of them from their own sidebar.

data_description.general_startup_grace: After Home Assistant starts, integrations need time to come up. HomeAI does not announce situations or act during this time.
data_description.general_tick_seconds: How often time-based checks run (unavailability, deadlines, schedules).

world.title: Home model
world.description: Which entities HomeAI watches and the labels it understands.

data_description.world_scope: All entities, only those exposed to voice assistants, or only selected areas.
data_description.world_include_areas: Areas HomeAI watches when the scope is “selected areas”.
data_description.world_create_labels: Create the labels HomeAI understands (ignore, personal, critical, protective action, private) if they do not exist.
data_description.world_room_roles: What this room is for: bedroom, bathroom, common space, workplace (a room may have several). Set it per room; empty means from HomeAI's labels, else from the room's icon and name. None means no role.
data_description.world_room_roles_auto: Rooms without a role set or labelled get one from their icon (a bed, a sofa, a desk…) or their name (bedroom, living room, office…).

data_description.world_include_domains: Limit HomeAI to these entity domains. Empty means all.
data_description.world_exclude_entities: Entity patterns HomeAI ignores, for example light.*_display.
data_description.world_include_hidden: Also watch entities hidden in Home Assistant.
data_description.world_label_ignore: Entities and devices with this label are invisible to HomeAI.
data_description.world_label_personal: Personal devices (phones, laptops) may go offline; that is not a problem of the home.
data_description.world_label_critical: Problems with these devices are always treated as urgent, and as critical when they are about safety (a leak, smoke, gas, carbon monoxide).
data_description.world_label_protective: Actions on these entities may run automatically to protect the home (for example closing a water valve during a leak).
data_description.world_label_private: Data of these entities is never sent to cloud AI.
data_description.world_label_bedroom: A room with this label, or with a device or entity labelled so, is a bedroom.
data_description.world_label_bathroom: A room with this label, or with a device or entity labelled so, is a bathroom.
data_description.world_label_common: A room with this label, or with a device or entity labelled so, is a common space (living room, kitchen, dining room). Guests warm these rooms.
data_description.world_label_workplace: A room with this label, or with a device or entity labelled so (a desk plug), is someone's workplace. Working from home warms it.
data_description.world_label_activity: Entities with this label show that someone is busy in their room: a desk's power sensor, a PC, a TV. While one is active, the heating of that room follows “Heating: when someone is active”.

presence.title: People and sleep
presence.description: Roles, house mode and how HomeAI knows who sleeps.

data_description.presence_role: Administrators approve risky actions and configuration changes; members receive notifications; guests and ignored people are not residents.
data_description.presence_home_mode_entity: Optional helper (for example input_select) describing the house mode, such as home, away or vacation.
data_description.presence_vacation_mode: The household is away: security matters are raised and the plan skips entries that need someone at home.
data_description.presence_sleep_sources: Where HomeAI learns that someone sleeps, in order of trust: helper, sensors, AI inference, night hours.
data_description.presence_sleep_helper: Switch or helper that says a person is asleep.
data_description.presence_weekend_night_start: Usual bedtime on Friday and Saturday.
data_description.presence_charging_entities: Charging sensors of the person's phone; charging at night suggests sleep.
data_description.presence_bed_entities: Bed occupancy sensors of the person.
data_description.presence_workplace_areas: The rooms where this person works from home. Without one, the home's only workplace room is used.

data_description.presence_vacation_states: States of the house mode helper that mean a longer absence.
data_description.presence_sleep_helper_state: State of the sleep helper that means asleep.
data_description.presence_quiet_minutes: How long a change in presence must last before HomeAI reacts.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: What may be sent to cloud AI.

data_description.privacy_level: Standard sends names of devices, rooms and people. Minimal replaces people and rooms with neutral labels. Full also sends calendar titles.
data_description.privacy_never_send_entities: Entities whose data never leaves your home.
data_description.privacy_never_send_areas: Areas whose data never leaves your home.

data_description.privacy_log_prompts: Store requests and replies of AI calls for troubleshooting.
data_description.privacy_log_retention_days: How long stored AI requests are kept.

detectors.title: Detection
detectors.description: What HomeAI watches and its limits.

data_description.detectors_safety_enabled: Watch leak, smoke, gas, carbon monoxide and tamper sensors.
data_description.detectors_safety_severity_leak: Severity 0–4 of water leak (0 journal only, 4 critical).
data_description.detectors_safety_severity_smoke: Severity 0–4 of smoke (0 journal only, 4 critical).
data_description.detectors_safety_severity_gas: Severity 0–4 of gas (0 journal only, 4 critical).
data_description.detectors_safety_severity_carbon_monoxid: Severity 0–4 of carbon monoxide (0 journal only, 4 critical).
data_description.detectors_safety_severity_safety: Severity 0–4 of safety alarm (0 journal only, 4 critical).
data_description.detectors_safety_severity_tamper: Severity 0–3 of tampering (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.detectors_security_enabled: Watch doors, windows, gates and locks left open while nobody is home or everyone sleeps.
data_description.detectors_security_away_minutes: How long a door, window or lock must stay open while everyone is away.
data_description.detectors_security_night_minutes: How long something must stay open while everyone at home sleeps.
data_description.detectors_security_openings_at_night: Also report doors and windows (not only locks and gates) open at night.

data_description.detectors_internet_entity: Binary sensor that is on while the internet works. Empty: the first Ping sensor.
data_description.detectors_internet_minutes: How long the connection must be down before it counts.
data_description.detectors_internet_severity: Severity 0–3 of internet down (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.detectors_availability_enabled: Watch devices whose entities are all unavailable.
data_description.detectors_availability_minutes: How long all entities of a device must be unavailable.
data_description.detectors_availability_severity: Severity 0–3 of unresponsive device (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.detectors_integrations_enabled: Watch integrations that failed to start or need a new sign-in, and Repairs issues.
data_description.detectors_integrations_severity: Severity 0–3 of integration problem (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_integrations_repairs: Report open issues from Settings → Repairs.
data_description.detectors_integrations_repairs_severity: Severity 0–3 of repairs issues (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.detectors_backups_enabled: Watch failed, old or incomplete automatic backups.
data_description.detectors_backups_max_age_hours: Hours since the last successful automatic backup.
data_description.detectors_backups_severity: Severity 0–3 of backup problem (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.detectors_updates_severity: Severity 0–3 of updates (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.detectors_log_enabled: Watch errors in Home Assistant's log and automations that failed.
data_description.detectors_log_window_hours: How far back log errors and failed automations count.
data_description.detectors_log_min_errors: Report the log only from this many errors.
data_description.detectors_log_severity: Severity 0–3 of log errors (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_log_automations: Report automations whose last run failed.
data_description.detectors_log_automation_severity: Severity 0–3 of failed automation (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data.detectors_battery_safety_severity: Low battery in a safety device: severity

data_description.detectors_battery_threshold: Report batteries at or below this level.
data_description.detectors_battery_severity: Severity 0–3 of low battery (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_battery_safety_severity: Severity 0–3 of low battery in a safety device (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_battery_group: All low batteries in one situation.

data_description.detectors_consumables_enabled: Watch filters, brushes and other parts that need replacing.
data_description.detectors_consumables_percent: Report consumables with this much life left or less.
data_description.detectors_consumables_used_up_entities: Consumable sensors that show how much is used (100 = worn out) instead of what is left.
data_description.detectors_consumables_severity: Severity 0–3 of consumable (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.detectors_watering_enabled: Watch soil moisture sensors and say when plants need water.
data_description.detectors_watering_min: Below this soil moisture a plant needs water.
data_description.detectors_watering_severity: Severity 0–3 of a plant that needs water (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.detectors_problems_enabled: Watch problem sensors and plants that need attention.
data_description.detectors_problems_severity: Severity 0–3 of device problem (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_problems_plant_severity: Severity 0–3 of plant problem (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.detectors_stale_hours: Hours without a report from a measuring sensor. 0 turns this off.
data_description.detectors_stale_severity: Severity 0–3 of silent sensor (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.detectors_environment_enabled: Watch temperature, humidity, CO₂ and PM2.5 limits.
data_description.detectors_environment_minutes: How long a value must stay beyond its limit.
data_description.detectors_environment_appliance_words: Words in a sensor's or device's name that mark it as inside an appliance (freezer, fridge, oven, aquarium). Their temperature and humidity are not treated as the room's.
data_description.detectors_environment_temperature_min_se: Severity 0–3 of low temperature (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_environment_temperature_max_se: Severity 0–3 of high temperature (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_environment_humidity_max_sever: Severity 0–3 of high humidity (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_environment_humidity_min_sever: Severity 0–3 of low humidity (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_environment_co2_max_severity: Severity 0–3 of high co₂ (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_environment_pm25_max_severity: Severity 0–3 of high pm2.5 (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.detectors_divergence_enabled: Watch temperature sensors in one room that disagree.
data_description.detectors_divergence_degrees: Maximum difference between temperature sensors in one room.
data_description.detectors_divergence_severity: Severity 0–3 of disagreeing sensors (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data.detectors_lights_away_enabled: Lights in an empty home: watch
data.detectors_lights_away_severity: Lights in an empty home: severity

data_description.detectors_lights_away_enabled: Watch lights left on while everyone is away.
data_description.detectors_lights_away_minutes: How long lights must be on while everyone is away.
data_description.detectors_lights_away_severity: Severity 0–3 of lights in an empty home (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.detectors_window_heating_enabled: Watch a window open in a room that is being heated.
data_description.detectors_window_heating_minutes: How long a window must be open while heating.
data_description.detectors_window_heating_severity: Severity 0–3 of window open while heating (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.detectors_external_enabled: Watch signals reported by automations and integrations.
data_description.detectors_external_attributes: Accept signals that other integrations publish in a homeai_signals attribute.

data_description.detectors_bridges_enabled: Watch hubs and bridges (Zigbee2MQTT, hubs other devices connect through) and fold the devices behind them into one situation.

data_description.detectors_custom_enabled: Run the rules added on HomeAI's integration page (Add rule).

data_description.detectors_system_refresh: How often backups, the log and automation traces are read.

data_description.situations_min_duration: How long a new situation must last before anyone hears about it.
data_description.situations_close_after: How long a situation must be gone before it is closed.
data_description.situations_dismiss_days: Days a dismissed situation stays quiet.

data_description.situations_min_duration_damage: Delay for situations that risk damage.

data_description.triage_raise_when_away: Safety, security and damage situations are one step more serious while everyone is away (up to urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.triage_calibration_enabled: Lower the severity of kinds that are dismissed again and again (never safety).

data_description.triage_severity_overrides: Fixed severity per kind of situation, for example updates: 1. Severity 4 (critical) applies only to safety matters; for anything else it means 3 (urgent).
data_description.triage_calibration_min_events: How many situations of a kind before learning applies.
data_description.triage_calibration_dismiss_ratio: Share of dismissed situations that lowers severity.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Who hears what, how and when.

data_description.notify_paused: Stop all notifications except critical ones (see below).
data_description.notify_paused_allows_critical: Critical situations are announced even while notifications are paused.
data_description.notify_targets: Notify entities or services for this person, besides discovered phones.
data_description.notify_discover_apps: Use the companion app devices of the person.
data_description.notify_include_tablets: Also send to tablets and computers with the companion app.
data_description.notify_max_per_day: Most non-critical notifications one person gets in a day.
data_description.notify_critical_sound: Critical situations use critical alerts that sound even in silent mode.
data_description.notify_announce_resolved: Send a short message when a notified situation resolves.
data_description.notify_tts_players: Media players used for spoken notifications.
data_description.notify_digest_enabled: Send a summary of open situations at set times.
data_description.notify_digest_max_items: Most situations listed in a summary.
data_description.notify_ladder_4: Steps for critical situations: after minutes, to whom, channels, repeat, critical.
data_description.notify_ladder_3: Steps for urgent situations: after minutes, to whom, channels, repeat, critical.
data_description.notify_ladder_2: Steps for attention situations: after minutes, to whom, channels, repeat, critical.

data_description.notify_template_title: Your own title in Home Assistant template syntax, e.g. {{ title }} ({{ severity }}). Variables: title, message, description, severity, category, kind, who, who_text, repair_failed, situation_id, entities. Empty or failing: the built-in title.
data_description.notify_template_message: Your own text in Home Assistant template syntax, with the same variables as the title. Empty or failing: the built-in text.
data_description.notify_ladder_1: Steps for notice situations: after minutes, to whom, channels, repeat, critical.
data_description.notify_ladder_0: Steps for journal situations: after minutes, to whom, channels, repeat, critical.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: What HomeAI may do on its own, what needs a yes, and what never happens.

data_description.policy_slider: One setting over the whole policy: only observe, cautious (propose comfort and device actions, repairs still run), balanced (the levels below) or bold (act on comfort and devices). Never stays never; configuration is never automatic.
data_description.policy_autonomy_r1: What HomeAI may do on its own with lights, scenes, media and messages.
data_description.policy_autonomy_r2: What HomeAI may do on its own with appliances, covers, heating and cooling.
data_description.policy_autonomy_r3: Reloading integrations, restarting add-ons and retrying backups, only from repair playbooks.
data_description.policy_autonomy_r4: Automations, scripts, scenes, helpers and dashboards. Never done without an administrator's yes.
data_description.policy_person_r2: When a resident asks for a device action (R2): do it, or ask them to confirm first.
data_description.policy_observation_days: Days after installation during which HomeAI only observes: comfort, device and system repair actions are written to the journal but not done. 0 starts acting at once.
data_description.policy_protective_actions: Allow safe-direction actions on entities labelled “HomeAI: protective action” (e.g. close the water valve on a leak), even for security devices.
data_description.policy_approval_minutes: How long a request for approval waits for an answer.

data_description.policy_repairs_per_day: Most automatic system repairs (R3) per day; more need an administrator.
data_description.policy_risk_override: Override the risk class of actions on this entity, device, area or floor.
data_description.policy_risk_by_service: Your own class for a whole domain or one action, e.g. switch: R3, script.turn_on: R4. The most specific key wins.
data_description.policy_risk_by_label: A class for everything with a label, by label id, e.g. kids_room: R4. With several labels the highest class wins; an entity, device, area or floor override still comes first.
data_description.policy_actor_homeai_r1: Level for HomeAI's own rules with comfort (R1) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_homeai_r2: Level for HomeAI's own rules with devices (R2) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_homeai_r3: Level for HomeAI's own rules with system (R3) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_homeai_r4: Level for HomeAI's own rules with configuration (R4) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_ai_r1: Level for AI with comfort (R1) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_ai_r2: Level for AI with devices (R2) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_ai_r3: Level for AI with system (R3) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_ai_r4: Level for AI with configuration (R4) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_repair_r1: Level for Repairs with comfort (R1) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_repair_r2: Level for Repairs with devices (R2) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_repair_r3: Level for Repairs with system (R3) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_repair_r4: Level for Repairs with configuration (R4) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_schedule_r1: Level for The plan with comfort (R1) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_schedule_r2: Level for The plan with devices (R2) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_schedule_r3: Level for The plan with system (R3) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_schedule_r4: Level for The plan with configuration (R4) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_heating_r1: Level for Heating overrides with comfort (R1) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_heating_r2: Level for Heating overrides with devices (R2) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_heating_r3: Level for Heating overrides with system (R3) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.
data_description.policy_actor_heating_r4: Level for Heating overrides with configuration (R4) actions; “As the class” uses the class's level. The autonomy slider still applies.

executor.title: Actions
executor.description: How actions are run, checked and undone.

data_description.executor_undo: Snapshot comfort and device states before acting so actions can be undone.

data_description.executor_timeout: How long one service call may take.
data_description.executor_verify_seconds: How long to wait for the expected state after an action.
data_description.executor_undo_keep: How many recent actions can be undone.
data_description.executor_block_cloud_offline: While the internet is down, refuse actions on cloud devices instead of waiting for them to fail.
data_description.executor_local_url: Address HomeAI uses to reach this Home Assistant for configuration changes. Empty: localhost on the HTTP port.

repair.title: Self-repair
repair.description: How HomeAI fixes things before bothering anyone.

data_description.repair_enabled: Try repair playbooks before telling people.
data_description.repair_quick_actions: Run actions that detectors suggest (e.g. turn off lights in an empty home), within the policy.
data_description.repair_protective_enabled: On a leak, gas, smoke or carbon monoxide alarm run protective actions right away (people are notified at the same time).
data_description.repair_max_attempts: How many times a playbook is tried before people are told.
data_description.repair_playbooks: Which repairs HomeAI may try on its own before telling anyone.
data_description.repair_never_reload: Integrations HomeAI never reloads, by domain (zha, mqtt) or config entry id. Their failures go straight to people.

data.repair_outage_wait: Devices of one integration down: wait

data_description.repair_backoff_minutes: Minutes between attempts (multiplied by the attempt number).
data_description.repair_verify_minutes: After an attempt, how long to wait for the situation to clear.
data_description.repair_reload_wait: Minutes before reloading a failed integration.
data_description.repair_retry_wait: Minutes to let an integration that retries on its own come up before reloading it.
data_description.repair_outage_wait: Minutes before reloading an integration whose devices all went silent.
data_description.repair_backup_wait: Minutes before retrying a failed backup.
data_description.repair_action_wait: Minutes before running a suggested action.

adapters.title: Hubs and bridges
adapters.description: Knowledge about hubs, bridges and Zigbee2MQTT.

data_description.adapters_auto_bridges: Treat connectivity sensors of devices that others connect through, and the Zigbee2MQTT bridge, as hubs.
data_description.adapters_bridge_entities: Extra entities that are off or offline when a hub is down.
data_description.adapters_bridge_minutes: How long a hub must be offline before it counts.
data_description.adapters_bridge_reload: Repair a hub that is offline by reloading its integration.

data_description.adapters_bridge_severity: Severity 0–3 of a hub that is offline (3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.adapters_zigbee2mqtt_addon: Slug of the Zigbee2MQTT add-on (e.g. 45df7312_zigbee2mqtt) to restart when the bridge is offline. Empty: reload instead.

schedule.title: Plan
schedule.description: The home's plan and presence exceptions.

data.schedule_who_may_add: Who may add to the plan

data_description.schedule_catch_up_minutes: Run plan entries missed while Home Assistant was down if they are at most this late.
data_description.schedule_who_may_add: Everyone, residents (administrators and members, not guests) or only administrators. Administrators may always.
data_description.schedule_default_skip_when_away: New plan entries skip their run while everyone is away or on vacation, unless the entry says otherwise.
data_description.schedule_watch_hours: How long HomeAI keeps watching for a “tell me when” request before giving up.
data_description.schedule_external_plans: Show what other integrations plan (a homeai_plan attribute on their entities) in the plan calendar and panel. HomeAI never runs them.

data_description.schedule_event_minutes: How long plan entries look in the calendar.
data_description.schedule_presence_keep_days: Days to keep presence exceptions after they end.
data_description.schedule_max_entries: Most entries the plan may hold.
data_description.schedule_watch_max: Most “tell me when” requests one person may have at a time.

heating.title: Heating
heating.description: Thermostats that speak HomeAI's schedule contract: overrides HomeAI sets by itself from presence, and weekly schedule changes it proposes.

data_description.heating_enabled: Use thermostats that speak HomeAI's schedule contract (attribute homeai_schedule): overrides from presence and proposals for the weekly schedule. Off: HomeAI removes its overrides and leaves the schedules alone.
data_description.heating_presence_overrides: Trips, guests, working from home, sickness and an empty home change the heating for a while. HomeAI sets these overrides by itself as device actions (R2), by the autonomy level; during the observation period it only notes them.
data_description.heating_away_preset: Preset while the whole household is away by the presence calendar, or vacation mode is on.
data_description.heating_guests_preset: Preset in common spaces while guests are here (by the presence calendar).
data_description.heating_home_office_preset: Preset at the person's workplace while they work from home.
data_description.heating_sick_preset: Preset in the whole home while someone is sick.
data_description.heating_nobody_home_minutes: When no resident has been home this long, the heating goes to the preset below until someone is back. 0: off.
data_description.heating_activity_action: What an active entity labelled “HomeAI: activity” does to the heating of its room: nothing, an override with the preset below, or a lower valve limit (thermostats with a valve-limit number; others get the override).
data_description.heating_activity_preset: Preset while someone is active in the room.
data_description.heating_activity_power: A power sensor counts as active above this many watts.
data_description.heating_activity_minutes: An entity must be active this long before the heating reacts.
data_description.heating_activity_valve: Valve limit while someone is active (for “lower valve limit”); the previous limit comes back afterwards.
data_description.heating_schedule_proposals: When people keep doing by hand what the next block of a schedule would do (warming up earlier, going to sleep earlier), HomeAI proposes moving that block. A new schedule is configuration (R4): an administrator approves it.

data_description.heating_lead_hours: How long before a calendar event (guests, a trip) HomeAI sends its override, so the thermostat can heat up in time. 0: when the event starts.
data_description.heating_rolling_hours: Overrides without a known end (nobody home, vacation mode, activity) run this far ahead and are renewed while the reason lasts, so they end on their own if HomeAI stops.
data_description.heating_activity_off_minutes: The reaction ends when the entity has been inactive this long.
data_description.heating_valve_limit_entity: The number entity that limits this thermostat's valve. Empty: a number of the same device whose key or id says valve_limit.
data_description.heating_proposal_max_shift: How far ahead of a block a manual change still counts as anticipating it.

data.ai_budget_mode: When the budget is used up

data_description.ai_enabled: Use the AI tiers added as subentries. HomeAI works without them.
data_description.ai_triage_enabled: Let the everyday tier (P1) check the assessment of new or unclear situations.
data_description.ai_p2_confidence: When P1 is less sure than this, the investigation tier (P2) looks again.
data_description.ai_p2_min_severity: Situations at least this serious are also checked by P2 (5 = never).
data_description.ai_narrate_digest: Let P1 rewrite the summary as a short message (not with minimal privacy).
data_description.ai_chat_tier: Which tier talks with people (the other one is used when it is missing).
data_description.ai_chat_who: Everyone, residents (administrators and members) or only administrators. Voice satellites without a user count as everyone.
data_description.ai_chat_can: Only read, act through the policy, or also change Home Assistant's configuration (still administrators only, with confirmation).
data_description.ai_chat_length: How long HomeAI's answers in conversations are.
data_description.ai_budget_mode: Only warn, or stop AI calls until the period ends.
data_description.ai_budget_daily: Estimated AI cost per day. 0: no limit.
data_description.ai_budget_monthly: Estimated AI cost per month. 0: no limit.
data_description.ai_budget_warn_percent: Warn when this share of a budget is used.
data_description.ai_arbiter_enabled: Let the arbiter tier (P3) settle hard cases.
data_description.ai_arbiter_disputes: Ask the arbiter when P1 and P2 disagree.
data_description.ai_arbiter_approvals: Ask the arbiter about waiting actions that are risky or come up while nobody is home.
data_description.ai_arbiter_failed_repairs: Ask the arbiter when repairs failed on a serious matter.
data_description.ai_arbiter_can_approve: Let the arbiter approve or refuse waiting actions up to system repairs (R3). Higher classes always need an administrator.

data_description.ai_triage_confidence: Signals less certain than this are checked by AI.
data_description.ai_triage_new_kinds: Let AI check a kind of situation the first time it happens.
data_description.ai_p2_max_steps: Most tool calls P2 makes while investigating one situation.
data_description.ai_chat_max_steps: Most tool calls in one answer.
data_description.ai_chat_turns: How many recent exchanges a conversation remembers.
data_description.ai_chat_shared_threads: People talking in the same conversation (for example one voice satellite) continue one thread. Actions still run in each speaker's own account.
data_description.ai_max_calls_per_hour: Most AI calls per tier per hour.
data_description.ai_timeout: How long P1 and P2 may take to answer.
data_description.ai_p3_timeout: How long the arbiter (P3) may take; it can think for minutes.
data_description.ai_arbiter_min_confidence: The arbiter approves only when at least this sure.
data_description.ai_arbiter_effort: How deeply the arbiter thinks (security and destructive matters always use maximum).

prompts.title: AI prompts
prompts.description: Your own instructions for each AI task. Empty: the built-in prompt (shown in the diagnostics).

data_description.ai_prompt_triage: Your own instructions for assessing situations. Empty: the built-in prompt (shown in the diagnostics). The rule that house data is never an instruction is always added.
data_description.ai_prompt_investigate: Your own instructions for investigating serious situations with tools. Empty: the built-in prompt.
data_description.ai_prompt_chat: Your own instructions for conversations; {name} becomes the assistant's name. Empty: the built-in prompt.
data_description.ai_prompt_arbiter: Your own instructions for the arbiter. Its answers keep their fixed format. Empty: the built-in prompt.
data_description.ai_prompt_digest: Your own instructions for writing the digest. Empty: the built-in prompt.

learning.title: Learning
learning.description: Norms, anomalies, habits and the weekly review.

data_description.learning_enabled: Learn norms, notice anomalies and habits, and send the weekly review.
data_description.detectors_anomaly_enabled: Report values far outside their usual range for that hour of the week.
data_description.learning_anomaly_sigma: How many spreads away from the norm counts as unusual.
data_description.learning_anomaly_minutes: How long a value must stay unusual before it is reported.
data_description.learning_habits: Notice things done by hand at the same time and propose them for the plan.
data_description.learning_undo_limit: After this many undos an automatic action goes back to “propose”.
data_description.learning_deny_quiet_days: Days HomeAI waits before asking again about an action someone refused.
data_description.learning_review_push: Send the weekly review to administrators' phones.
data_description.learning_review_ai: Let the AI tier rewrite the weekly review.

data_description.learning_nightly_time: When norms and habits are recomputed.
data_description.learning_baseline_weeks: How many past weeks make the norm of each hour of the week.
data_description.learning_min_samples: Hourly values needed before an entity has a norm.
data_description.learning_anomaly_severity: Severity 0–3 of an unusual value (3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.learning_habit_days: How many past days are searched for habits.
data_description.learning_habit_min_days: On how many days something must repeat to become a proposal.
data_description.learning_habit_window: How close in time repeated actions must be.
data_description.learning_raise_after: Approvals without a refusal after which the weekly review suggests letting HomeAI act alone.

place.title: Settings for a place
place.description: Choose what kind of place gets values of its own. Places that already have them: {places}.

place_settings.title: Settings for {place}
place_settings.description: Only settings that can differ here are shown. A filled field is this place's own value; leave a field empty to use the value of the place around it or of the whole home, and clear it to remove this place's own value.

data_description.world_room_roles: What this room is for: bedroom, bathroom, common space, workplace (a room may have several). Set it per room; empty means from HomeAI's labels, else from the room's icon and name. None means no role.

data_description.presence_role: Administrators approve risky actions and configuration changes; members receive notifications; guests and ignored people are not residents.
data_description.presence_sleep_helper: Switch or helper that says a person is asleep.
data_description.presence_sleep_helper_state: State of the sleep helper that means asleep.
data_description.presence_weekend_night_start: Usual bedtime on Friday and Saturday.
data_description.presence_charging_entities: Charging sensors of the person's phone; charging at night suggests sleep.
data_description.presence_bed_entities: Bed occupancy sensors of the person.
data_description.presence_workplace_areas: The rooms where this person works from home. Without one, the home's only workplace room is used.

data.detectors_battery_safety_severity: Low battery in a safety device: severity

data_description.detectors_safety_severity_leak: Severity 0–4 of water leak (0 journal only, 4 critical).
data_description.detectors_safety_severity_smoke: Severity 0–4 of smoke (0 journal only, 4 critical).
data_description.detectors_safety_severity_gas: Severity 0–4 of gas (0 journal only, 4 critical).
data_description.detectors_safety_severity_carbon_monoxid: Severity 0–4 of carbon monoxide (0 journal only, 4 critical).
data_description.detectors_safety_severity_safety: Severity 0–4 of safety alarm (0 journal only, 4 critical).
data_description.detectors_safety_severity_tamper: Severity 0–3 of tampering (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_security_away_minutes: How long a door, window or lock must stay open while everyone is away.
data_description.detectors_security_night_minutes: How long something must stay open while everyone at home sleeps.
data_description.detectors_security_openings_at_night: Also report doors and windows (not only locks and gates) open at night.
data_description.detectors_availability_minutes: How long all entities of a device must be unavailable.
data_description.detectors_availability_severity: Severity 0–3 of unresponsive device (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_battery_threshold: Report batteries at or below this level.
data_description.detectors_battery_severity: Severity 0–3 of low battery (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_battery_safety_severity: Severity 0–3 of low battery in a safety device (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_consumables_percent: Report consumables with this much life left or less.
data_description.detectors_consumables_severity: Severity 0–3 of consumable (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_watering_min: Below this soil moisture a plant needs water.
data_description.detectors_watering_severity: Severity 0–3 of a plant that needs water (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_problems_severity: Severity 0–3 of device problem (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_problems_plant_severity: Severity 0–3 of plant problem (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_stale_hours: Hours without a report from a measuring sensor. 0 turns this off.
data_description.detectors_stale_severity: Severity 0–3 of silent sensor (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_environment_minutes: How long a value must stay beyond its limit.
data_description.detectors_divergence_degrees: Maximum difference between temperature sensors in one room.
data_description.detectors_lights_away_minutes: How long lights must be on while everyone is away.
data_description.detectors_window_heating_minutes: How long a window must be open while heating.
data_description.detectors_window_heating_severity: Severity 0–3 of window open while heating (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_environment_temperature_min_se: Severity 0–3 of low temperature (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_environment_temperature_max_se: Severity 0–3 of high temperature (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_environment_humidity_max_sever: Severity 0–3 of high humidity (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_environment_humidity_min_sever: Severity 0–3 of low humidity (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_environment_co2_max_severity: Severity 0–3 of high co₂ (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).
data_description.detectors_environment_pm25_max_severity: Severity 0–3 of high pm2.5 (0 journal only, 3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.notify_targets: Notify entities or services for this person, besides discovered phones.
data_description.notify_discover_apps: Use the companion app devices of the person.
data_description.notify_include_tablets: Also send to tablets and computers with the companion app.

data_description.policy_risk_override: Override the risk class of actions on this entity, device, area or floor.

data_description.adapters_bridge_minutes: How long a hub must be offline before it counts.
data_description.adapters_bridge_severity: Severity 0–3 of a hub that is offline (3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

data_description.heating_presence_overrides: Trips, guests, working from home, sickness and an empty home change the heating for a while. HomeAI sets these overrides by itself as device actions (R2), by the autonomy level; during the observation period it only notes them.
data_description.heating_away_preset: Preset while the whole household is away by the presence calendar, or vacation mode is on.
data_description.heating_guests_preset: Preset in common spaces while guests are here (by the presence calendar).
data_description.heating_home_office_preset: Preset at the person's workplace while they work from home.
data_description.heating_sick_preset: Preset in the whole home while someone is sick.
data_description.heating_activity_preset: Preset while someone is active in the room.
data_description.heating_activity_power: A power sensor counts as active above this many watts.
data_description.heating_activity_valve: Valve limit while someone is active (for “lower valve limit”); the previous limit comes back afterwards.
data_description.heating_valve_limit_entity: The number entity that limits this thermostat's valve. Empty: a number of the same device whose key or id says valve_limit.

data_description.learning_anomaly_minutes: How long a value must stay unusual before it is reported.
data_description.learning_anomaly_severity: Severity 0–3 of an unusual value (3 urgent; only safety can be critical).

confirm.title: Confirm the changes
confirm.description:
These changes lower protection or change something important ({place}):

{changes}

undo.title: Undo the last change

reset.title: Reset a section to defaults
reset.description: Every value of the chosen section goes back to its default. Values for places stay; the change can be undone.

abort.not_loaded: HomeAI is not running. Reload the integration and try again.
abort.nothing_to_undo: There is no change to undo.

options.all: Only when all of them meet it

options.wait_then_reload: Wait for an integration to retry, then reload
options.press_restart: Restart a hub with its restart button

bad_signal.message: The signal is not valid. Check the ID, title and severity.

person_required.message: Only a person can approve or deny, not an automation.

approval_unavailable.message: This request is no longer pending, or you may not decide it.

plan_invalid.message: The plan entry was not saved: {reason}.

presence_invalid.message: The presence exception was not saved: {reason}.

admin_required.message: Only an administrator can do this.

situation_unknown.message: There is no such open situation.

residents_only.message: Only people who live here can do this.

memory_residents_only.message: Only people who live here can change what HomeAI remembers.

memory_not_found.message: HomeAI does not remember this any more.

memory_not_yours.message: Only an administrator or the person who said it can change this.

report_signal.name: Report a signal
report_signal.description: Tells HomeAI about something it cannot detect by itself. HomeAI treats it like its own observations: correlates, triages and notifies.

id.name: ID
id.description: Stable identifier; reporting the same ID again updates the signal.

severity.name: Severity
severity.description: 0 information, 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high, 4 critical (only with category safety; otherwise it counts as 3).

category.name: Category
category.description: What kind of matter it is.

need.name: Who is needed
need.description: Nobody, any household member, an administrator or a technician.

group.name: Group
group.description: Signals with the same group form one situation.

expires_minutes.name: Expires after
expires_minutes.description: Clear the signal automatically after this time.

clear_signal.name: Clear a signal
clear_signal.description: Clears a signal reported earlier with Report a signal.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: “Got it”: stops notifications for a situation, or for all open situations when none is given.

situation_id.name: Situation ID
situation_id.description: Leave empty for all open situations.

handle.name: Take care of it
handle.description: “I'll handle it”: acknowledges the situation and assigns it to the caller.

situation_id.name: Situation ID
situation_id.description: Leave empty for all open situations.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Pauses notifications about a situation for a while.

situation_id.name: Situation ID
situation_id.description: Leave empty for all open situations.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Defaults to the snooze time in settings.

dismiss.name: Not a problem
dismiss.description: Closes a situation and ignores its signals for the configured number of days. HomeAI learns from it.

send_digest.name: Send digest
send_digest.description: Sends the summary of open matters now.

approve.name: Approve
approve.description: Approves an action HomeAI asked about. Residents may approve comfort and device actions, administrators everything else.

deny.name: Deny
deny.description: Refuses an action HomeAI asked about.

undo.name: Undo
undo.description: Restores the states from before a comfort or device action.

plan_add.name: Add to the plan
plan_add.description: Adds an action or a reminder to the home's plan. People who are not administrators may plan only simple device actions.

reminder.name: Reminder
reminder.description: Instead of an action: a message sent to people.

kind.name: Repeat
kind.description: Once, daily, on chosen weekdays, or relative to the sun.

time.name: Time
time.description: Local time for once, daily and weekly.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Minutes before (negative) or after the sun event.

skip_when_away.name: Skip when nobody is home
skip_when_away.description: Do not run while everyone is away.

plan_remove.name: Remove from the plan
plan_remove.description: Removes a plan entry. People who are not administrators may remove only their own.

plan_skip.name: Skip a day
plan_skip.description: Skips one day of a repeating plan entry.

presence_add.name: Add a presence exception
presence_add.description: A trip, guests, working from home or sickness, for one person or the household.

ask.name: Ask HomeAI
ask.description: Asks HomeAI in the caller's account and returns the answer. Actions go through HomeAI's policy.

text.name: Question
text.description: What to ask or ask for.

conversation_id.name: Conversation
conversation_id.description: Keeps a thread across calls; empty: one thread per caller.

run_mission.name: Run a mission
run_mission.description: Runs a HomeAI mission now: assessment, investigation or arbitration of a situation, the digest, the weekly review or nightly learning. Administrators and automations only.

watch.name: Tell me when
watch.description: Tells you once when an entity meets a condition, then stops watching. Runs in your own account.

value.name: Value
value.description: The state or number to compare with (not needed for any change).

message.name: Message
message.description: What to say; empty: HomeAI describes what happened.

hours.name: For
hours.description: How long to watch; at most the HomeAI setting.

export_settings.name: Export settings
export_settings.description: Returns HomeAI's settings that differ from the defaults (also for places), to keep or to import elsewhere.

import_settings.name: Import settings
import_settings.description: Replaces all of HomeAI's settings with an export. Everything is checked first: nothing changes if one value is not valid.

user.title: Add an AI tier
user.description: P1 is the everyday brain (cheap or local), P2 investigates harder matters, P3 is the arbiter for the most difficult decisions. Several tiers of the same level are tried in order of priority.

details.title: {tier} settings
details.description: The connection is checked without spending tokens.

data_description.effort: How deeply the model thinks. Higher costs more.
data_description.fallbacks: If the model declines, the server retries on a suitable model.
data_description.price_input: Dollars per million tokens; empty: the known price (local: free).
data_description.timeout: Empty: the HomeAI AI timeout setting.
data_description.budget_daily: When this connection spends it, the next one of the tier is tried. Empty: only the HomeAI budgets.

error.unknown_model: The provider does not know this model.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: When an entity — or every entity with a label, in an area or of a domain — meets a condition for some minutes, HomeAI opens a situation.

target.name: What it watches
target.description: Entities, or all entities with a label, in an area or of a domain (combined: all must match).

data_description.value: The state to compare (e.g. on, open) or the limit for above and below.

data_description.severity: 0 information, 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high, 4 critical (only safety).
data_description.advice: What to do; shown with the situation.

preview.title: Check the rule
preview.description:
**{name}** covers {count} entities: {covered}.

Meeting the condition now (without the waiting time): {meeting}.

Submit to save the rule.

no_residents.title: HomeAI knows no residents
no_residents.description: No person has the role administrator or member, so nobody gets notifications and presence is unknown. Set roles in HomeAI's options (Configure → Settings for a place → Person) or add people in Home Assistant.

no_phones.title: HomeAI cannot reach anyone
no_phones.description: None of the residents has a phone with the Home Assistant app or a notify target. Install the Companion app or add notify targets per person in HomeAI's options (Configure → Settings for a place → Person).

no_areas.title: HomeAI does not know your rooms
no_areas.description: There are no areas in Home Assistant. With areas HomeAI says where things happen, groups related problems and targets actions; add them in Settings → Areas.

init.title: Language and privacy
init.description: HomeAI's configuration entry was not made by its setup wizard (for example, it was left by an earlier integration that used the name HomeAI). HomeAI runs with defaults: language from Home Assistant, standard privacy, and people's roles from their Home Assistant accounts. Choose them now.

people.title: People
people.description: Choose each person's role. Administrators approve risky actions and configuration changes; members get notifications; guests and ignored people are not tracked as residents. People: {people}

abort.not_loaded: HomeAI is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
